entities.summary:
Carlo Marsuppini (1399–1453), also known as Carlo Aretino and Carolus Arretinus, was an Italian Renaissance humanist and chancellor of the Florentine Republic.

A prominent figure in the Italian Renaissance, Marsuppini played a crucial role in the cultural and intellectual landscape of 15th-century Italy. He was instrumental in shaping the city's politics, economy, and education system, leaving a lasting legacy in the region.

As a humanist and diplomat, Marsuppini's contributions extended to the realm of art and literature, influencing the development of Italian literature and music during the Renaissance period.
